title: Validation error state
description: Danger alert plus inline field errors — Canada.ca has no global error summary, so errors stay with their fields.

components.reason: Page-level danger alert stating submission failed and why
Instantiate with has-error on the group and inline error text (role='alert') per failing field

nesting: Danger alert 1 above the form; errored fields (2 in error state) inside their form groups; button 3 last
validationOrder: Every failing field shows inline error text with role='alert' — do not add a global error summary (none exists in the design system)
Both language versions of the error text exist
a11yNotes: role='alert' on the danger alert announces the failure
Inline error text near each field keeps error-context association
Colour never the only carrier of meaning
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the danger alert at the top of main describing the failure
2. For each failing field: has-error on the form-group, inline error text with role='alert'
4. Provide EN and FR error strings
